g.aria-label: BPE-Dropout and MaxMatch-Dropout expose NLP models to various tokenization but the distribution is imbalanced (provably for all p!)
but it can be made balanced:

Tokenization can be represented as a lattice. Any walk from the start state to an accepting state is a valid tokenization.
A tokenization can be uniformly sampled in linear time.
Uniform sampling increases the number of observed tokenizations which helps in machine translation:
Marco Cognetta Vilém Zouhar Naoaki Okazaki
